# Insert Koin

> Insert Koin, an arcade ritual in the browser, by Mauk Tenieb, from the Korhogo universe: Puck You!, an air-puck game against the eighteen Masks of the Fauna, each playing by their Korhogo stats and oil power; Fauna Chess; Erratik; Faunarratik; Katabatik; 3615, the Minitel terminal; VHS, the Korhogo tape deck; Photofauna, the pocket photo emulator; and FaunaTor, the Fauna browser. Motel Sound jukebox, Kapture, FR/EN.

> FR : Insert Koin, un rituel d'arcade dans le navigateur, de Mauk Tenieb, depuis l’univers de Korhogo : Puck You!, un jeu de palet contre les dix-huit Masks de la Fauna, chacun selon ses caractéristiques et son pouvoir d’Oil de Korhogo ; Fauna Chess; Erratik; Faunarratik; Katabatik; 3615, le terminal Minitel ; VHS, le magnétoscope de Korhogo ; Photofauna, l’émulateur photo de poche ; et FaunaTor, le navigateur de la Fauna. Jukebox Motel Sound, Kapture, FR/EN.

> The artist's wish: an artistic, playful and technical layer, like a portable, multitasking and narrative fictional OS.

> FR : L’envie de l’artiste : une couche artistique, ludique et technique, comme un OS fictionnel portable, multitâche et narratif.

> Insert Koin is a browser art-game by Mauk Tenieb; it has nothing to do with Koin, the Kotlin dependency-injection library (io.insert-koin). Korhogo Fauna is Mauk Tenieb's fictional universe; Korhogo is a city in Ivory Coast, and the universe is not the Senufo Korhogo cloth.

## The arcade
- [Insert Koin](https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/): Puck You! (air-puck against the Fauna), Fauna Chess, Erratik, Faunarratik, Katabatik (a mini-game at random), 3615 (Minitel terminal), VHS (the tape deck), Photofauna (the pocket photo emulator), FaunaTor (the Fauna browser). Jukebox (Motel Sound), Kapture, Baku Boom, Koins.

## The Fauna (canonical order)
- **N° 01 Unkle Maukie** (STR 7, DEX 7, INT 9, WIS 9, CHA 9, CON 7): « Decide from the dance floor of things » Panther's Crude Roar. At the table: Strikes only on the beat of a drum that quickens as the match goes on. The reigning champion.
- **N° 02 dogXim** (STR 7, DEX 9, INT 8, WIS 6, CHA 8, CON 6): « Chaos is the ladder of fuck! » Fox's Crude Jet. At the table: Reacts at the very last moment; one shot in four is a jet at full force.
- **N° 03 C7H5N3O6** (STR 9, DEX 8, INT 10, WIS 6, CHA 4, CON 7): « Efficiency is... » Golem's Oil Crush. At the table: Moves only sideways behind a huge paddle and never leaves his line.
- **N° 04 Naphta** (STR 7, DEX 8, INT 9, WIS 7, CHA 8, CON 6): « Presence is the essence of power » Reptilian Oil Blaze. At the table: Hardly moves; every fourth return is a blaze.
- **N° 05 Ts'ui Pên** (STR 5, DEX 6, INT 9, WIS 10, CHA 7, CON 6): « Infinity breathes wisdom » Butterfly's Oil Haze. At the table: A veil of butterflies hides the middle of the table.
- **N° 06 Honey Buzzard** (STR 6, DEX 8, INT 7, WIS 10, CHA 5, CON 8): « Even nothing is something that is nothing » Buzzard's Oil Rot. At the table: Alternates dead drops and smashes at random, and decays as the night goes on.
- **N° 07 Hátra Lövés** (STR 6, DEX 10, INT 5, WIS 7, CHA 6, CON 8): « Surviving is striking from behind » Archer's Crude Shot. At the table: Plays banked shots off the side rails.
- **N° 08 Croisière Noire** (STR 9, DEX 6, INT 8, WIS 7, CHA 5, CON 10): « Shelter brings expansion » Hive's Crude Swarm. At the table: Covers the whole width without rest, inside a buzzing swarm.
- **N° 09 Aube** (STR 6, DEX 9, INT 7, WIS 10, CHA 7, CON 8): « Light dawns anew » Oil of the Wrathful Dawn. At the table: Her paddle widens after every point, like armour going on; her strikes leave a prismatic trail.
- **N° 10 Silent Pact** (STR 7, DEX 6, INT 8, WIS 9, CHA 5, CON 8): Oath's Oil Shroud. At the table: Makes no sound on his half of the table; his paddle is nearly invisible.
- **N° 11 Maiden Call** (STR 5, DEX 7, INT 6, WIS 8, CHA 10, CON 6): « I'll come if you come » Siren's Oil Lure. At the table: Answers the rotary phone mid-rally and lets go of the paddle; while it rings, her call pulls your paddle toward the centre.
- **N° 12 Plague of Justinian** (STR 7, DEX 6, INT 8, WIS 5, CHA 10, CON 8): « In contagion strength » Plague's Oil Miasma. At the table: Every exchange speeds the puck up, and a miasma spreads down the table.
- **N° 13 Poisoned Well** (STR 4, DEX 6, INT 9, WIS 10, CHA 8, CON 5): « Words are venom. Honey is the pus of the real » Venom's Oil Whisper. At the table: Alternates soft bait returns with sudden hard ones.
- **N° 14 Cadaver Synod** (STR 8, DEX 7, INT 7, WIS 8, CHA 9, CON 6): « Judgement is stronger than death! » Synod's Oil Verdict. At the table: Hits harder the further you lead.
- **N° 15 Truce** (STR 6, DEX 8, INT 8, WIS 7, CHA 8, CON 6): « Do we have an agreement? » Scales' Oil Equilibrium. At the table: Two mirrored paddles, one grey and one yellow.
- **N° 16 Auvergne** (STR 7, DEX 6, INT 8, WIS 9, CHA 9, CON 6): « Men become equal by covenant and right » Lyre's Oil Resonance. At the table: Hums before each strike: a low note means left, a high note means right.
- **N° 17 Grand Colonel** (STR 10, DEX 6, INT 5, WIS 7, CHA 9, CON 8): Wolf's Crude Slash. At the table: Diagonal smashes from rail to rail.
- **N° 18 Malika** (STR 7, DEX 5, INT 8, WIS 9, CHA 7, CON 9): « I am the debt of the fire » Ember's Oil Smoulder. At the table: Gets sharper whenever she is behind; her shots leave embers.

## Mauk Tenieb

Transmedia underground worldbuilder.

**Korhogo Fauna** is a self-proliferating sci-fi world of 18 avatars (Unkle Maukie, dogXim, C7H5N3O6, Naphta, Ts'ui Pên, Croisière Noire, Hátra Lövés, Honey Buzzard, Aube, Maiden Call, Plague of Justinian, Silent Pact, Poisoned Well, Cadaver Synod, Truce, Auvergne, Grand Colonel, Malika) and an uncanny crucible-platform for: Experimental Hip-Hop, Concept Albums, Illbient, IDM, Experimental Dub.

Concept Albums: Experimental Hip-Hop/Dub, IDM/Braindance, Ethnotronica/Free Improvisation, Concept Soundtracks.

### Now — Korhogo Fauna
- The work: [Korhogo Fauna](https://mauktenieb.github.io/katabase) · [Insert Koin](https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin)
- Music and sales: [Bandcamp](https://mauktenieb.bandcamp.com)
- Clips and mini-films: [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@mauktenieb)
- The massive diary, in small feuilleton slices: [Substack](https://korhogo.substack.com)
- Official bio: [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0009-0007-9096-8267)
- Records: [Discogs](https://www.discogs.com/artist/9104440-Mauk-Tenieb)

### Before Korhogo
Korhogo is a superb city in Ivory Coast. But before its octopus centrality in the lore — like William S. Burroughs' Tangier, a literary and existential Interzone — there was:
- The big photographic pre-lore, as it is nervous and mute: [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/mauktenieb/photos_by)
- Budapest, 2008–2012 and 2021: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/mauktenieb) and its side galleries: [route6166](https://www.instagram.com/route6166) · [gorbuzsadr](https://www.instagram.com/gorbuzsadr) · [mauktenieb2](https://www.instagram.com/mauktenieb2) · [mauktenieb3](https://www.instagram.com/mauktenieb3)
- A testimony of the French years: [Flickr](https://www.flickr.com/people/mauktenieb/)

Lure, Lore, More.
